summary: Today’s pulse tracks North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row, Australian politics live: Hanson ‘delighted’ as Liberal senator defects to One Nation; Bowen says global tensions ‘infected’ Cop31, and US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify. Across BBC and Guardian, the strongest repeated signals are duran, nation, and senator. In the background, Andy Taylor, guitarist in Duran Duran, dies aged 65 and Flinders Island bushfire grows to 13,000 hectares with Tasmanian homes and properties at risk keep the wider picture in motion.

headlines.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
headlines.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.

headlines.title: Australian politics live: Hanson ‘delighted’ as Liberal senator defects to One Nation; Bowen says global tensions ‘infected’ Cop31
headlines.description: Blyth is the second high-profile federal defection from the Coalition to One Nation – after Barnaby Joyce . Senator Blyth will be One Nation’s first South Australian Senator and will build on One Nation’s expanding support within the state. My team and I are delighted to welcome Senator Blyth to sit in the Senate with One Nation. We are facing at the next election clearly a coalition of the Liberals, Nationals and One Nation, with all the baggage that each of these parties brings to the table. They’re all anti-worker, they’re all extreme … this demonstrates, I think, more disunity in the Liberal party under Angus Taylor .

headlines.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
headlines.description: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

headlines.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist in Duran Duran, dies aged 65
headlines.description: Musician who had huge 1980s chart success had been diagnosed with prostate cancer in 2018 Andy Taylor, the guitarist with 80s pop megastars Duran Duran, has died aged 65. He had been diagnosed with stage four metastatic prostate cancer in 2018, which he disclosed publicly in 2022 when Duran Duran were about to be inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

headlinePool.title: New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade postponed due to weather
headlinePool.description: Forecasters say high winds on Thursday may spoil the annual march of huge balloons and have moved the parade to Saturday New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade has been postponed due to excessively windy weather and will now be held on Saturday. Forecasters say an impending storm on Thursday may spoil the street party, which is marked by a march of huge balloons. AccuWeather is forecasting winds of 12 to 25 mph (19 to 40 km/h) and rain later on Thursday.

headlinePool.title: At this Little Free Bakery in Austin, neighbors come for the pastries and stay for community connection
headlinePool.description: Little Free Bakeries are popping up across the country. While they each operate a bit differently, the goal is the same: offering their neighbors a sweet treat to encourage conversation with a side of community. We focus on Sarah Mason, who started Little Free Bakery North Loop in her Austin neighborhood and Lanne Rosebrook Stauffer, who founded the first Little Free Bakery in Seattle and just celebrated five years of weekly bakes.

headlinePool.title: All hostages rescued after Colombian security forces storm supermarket, police say
headlinePool.description: Unclear if ‘hostage-taker’ who was killed may have been a hostage as daylong siege in Cartagena shopping centre ends Colombian police have stormed a supermarket in one of the country’s most popular tourist cities, ending a daylong siege in which all the hostages were freed and one man police described as a hostage-taker was killed. Abelardo de la Espriella, the far-right president, travelled to the Caribbean port city of Cartagena to follow the final hours of negotiations and the tactical assault, in which special forces officers broke through blocked entrances and detonated stun grenades.

headlinePool.title: Judge orders transfer of Thomas Markle to face formal charges in California
headlinePool.description: Father of the Duchess of Sussex currently being held in Florida is charged with possession of child pornography A judge in the US has ordered the transfer of Thomas Markle, the Duchess of Sussex’s father, to California to face formal charges of possessing child sex abuse images. The move comes after a federal grand jury on the west coast paved the way for the prosecution of Markle Sr, who is currently being held in custody in Florida. He was charged with two counts of possession of child pornography.

headlinePool.title: Oregon man and dog narrowly escape being swept away by high tides as officials urge caution at beaches
headlinePool.description: Record-breaking king tides have prompted west coast authorities to warn residents to stay away from beaches The US west coast has seen record-breaking tides this week and authorities have urged residents to avoid beaches, but not everyone is heeding those warnings. In Cannon Beach, Oregon , viral footage showed a man and his dog nearly getting swept away by a so-called king tide on Tuesday morning. The man had been standing on a staircase holding his leashed dog, who was walking in the sand, when the water suddenly surged, knocking him to his feet.

headlinePool.title: High levels of salmonella found in some products from nation’s biggest turkey producer
headlinePool.description: Two years of inspections at four Butterball plants show rates far exceeding US averages in ground or chopped meat Inspectors found salmonella bacteria in more than a third of ground or chopped turkey samples at slaughterhouses owned by Butterball, the US’s biggest turkey company, data shows. The US Department of Agriculture’s (USDA) food safety and inspection service (FSIS) and some states conduct regular checks for salmonella and other bacteria in commercial poultry plants. Salmonella can live in the intestines of poultry, and it can cause nausea, diarrhea and even death in humans if meat is not cooked properly and then consumed.
